comments.content:
Normally only the first time the task was completed will it be marked as complete - but also requires the deliverables to be associated. Seems that redundant work was done, but it isn't clear to me if there is a redundant bounty.
@Hodlatoor can you link the redundant task?

I suggest making a special effort to make your task specifications as clear as possible, in this case by titling them with exactly the same title that Gnosis refers to them as, and with links to the correct landing and submission pages. 
Anybody else working on business development will have more clarity on what was worked on.
I appreciate the screenshot proof. It could be more effective for realtime team collaboration if the screenshot/proof is posted right away upon task completion. 
Reaching out on all of their available channels should increase our chances of conversion.
Makes sense I think its a good idea.
---
As a side note: I have a feeling that it only makes sense to make bounties on deliverables like the content for the submissions. The actual submission process itself, unless its on GitHub in the form of a pull request like with W3F, I think its a bit awkward to prove. 
Documents are searchable and workable, and make sense to submit via a pull request to our team's repository. Perhaps the DevPool flow is only really useful for collaborative projects (e.g. editing and reviewing a markdown document) vs single person projects (submitting a web form.)
A screenshot works as a workaround, but seems not very elegant because we won't keep that in the repository (so we can't submit it via a pull request and go through the standard review process.) 
So it only makes sense to post in a comment, but then we can't do the standard review process. 
But I fear that screenshots would mostly clutter the repository if submitted as a pull request and saved in the repository.
Hey @sergfeldman my apologies for the slow review. It hasn't been easy for me to be on GitHub these days.

Mostly good just think that it should be made clear that the card isn't available. I also think that maybe we can think of tighter integrations with the Gnosis infrastructure. 
Lastly this makes me think that we should update our index ubq.fi copywriting at the top.
